name: football-data.co.uk
description: Historical results, match statistics, xG (2026-27 on) and bookmaker odds

name: Fantasy Premier League API
description: Current fixtures, scores, players, xG/xA, prices and injury news (unofficial)

name: FPL player history
description: Season-by-season player totals, including xG since 2022-23

name: transfermarkt-datasets
description: Third-party public dumps: valuations, transfers and appearances
note: The dataset's maintainers paused updates in July 2026 and have given no return date. Values stay frozen until they resume, and the model estimates each player's next value from that last figure.
coverage: 3521 players, 74889 valuations to 2026-06-10, 633/670 current FPL players linked

name: football-data.org
description: Official-style fixtures, results and standings (free key required)

name: Understat
description: Team expected goals per match, via the soccerdata package (optional)
note: Nothing depends on this. Understat's site is down, and team xG comes from football-data.co.uk instead.
